## Findings

1. **High** — [runtime_defaults.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/runtime_defaults.rs:135) says the `JIT_LOCK_TIMEOUT`-derived timeout applies only to `JsonFileStorage`’s shared `FileLocker`. However, [JsonFileStorage::new](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:121) passes that same timeout to `RepoWriteLock::for_storage_root`, which creates and acquires `.jit/.repo-write.lock` through its own `FileLocker` ([repo_lock.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/repo_lock.rs:108)). This omits a real operational scope from the required projection, failing REQ-01.
